blurb: Guests fish for Speckled Trout, Redfish, Flounder, and other species in Galveston Bay. Trips include drifting and wade fishing using a custom 25’ Shallow Sport X3 boat equipped with modern electronics and safety gear. The service accommodates both experienced anglers and beginners, including families and kids.
extraNote: Weather cancellations at the discretion of the Captain · Tips are appreciated
